dsh-LorebookMD 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

posts.en:
dsh-LorebookMD is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-23158b2fc9c133b31aac.html
